rationale: Standing CZ legal-publishing feed on financial-market law changes; recurring signal on banking/capital-market deadlines.
Valuable English syndication of CZ firm alerts but deep-link failed and Lexology often gates content; recheck liveness and access.
Useful CZ finance/banking jurisdiction index, but Mondaq articles sit behind registration — human must clear access.
Single DORA seminar page on cbaeducaplus.cz; monitor the training-catalogue parent instead of this event.
Authoritative versioned CERTIS rulebook page from CNB with dated effective dates binding all CZ interbank participants.
CERTIS section hub is the best snowball/monitoring node for CZ payment-system rule changes; distinct from generic cnb.cz siblings.
Proxy-register description sits under the CERTIS hub already monitored; keep as sub-page coverage.
SCT Inst rulebook page carries hard dated scheme obligations applying to CZ PSPs; core A3 deadline source.
SCT rulebook/IG page with ISO 20022 and structured-address deadlines relevant to CZ EUR SEPA traffic.
Per-scheme participant registers give repeatable, quantifiable reads on CZ PSP adherence over time.
Adherence-process documentation is a stable EPC sub-page under the scheme pages already tracked.
VoP scheme page holds the headline 9 July 2027 non-euro-area deadline directly binding Czech PSPs and vendors.
EPC consultation listing is the earliest forward signal of dated rulebook changes; monitor the consultation stream.
One-off ERPB meeting PDF — good dated evidence on scheme readiness, not a recurring feed.
COBS is the de-facto CZ open-banking standard with versioned implementation windows; central A3 source.
Machine-readable, version-tagged COBS repo gives exact release dates — ideal automated deadline tracking.
Independent CZ PSD2/API-status aggregator would cross-check COBS adoption, but URL verification failed; recheck liveness.
Bank iD publishes dated, versioned contractual annexes and SLAs binding IdPs and relying parties — exactly this cell's target.
IdP obligations page is a sibling section of bankid.cz already covered by the contractual-documentation source.
Public Visa rulebook PDF on a fixed semi-annual edition cycle; each edition is a dated obligation set for CZ licensees.
Public Mastercard Rules PDF, regularly re-issued, source of dated mandates binding CZ issuers/acquirers.
Consumer-facing CZ landing page that only points to the global Visa rules already tracked; adds no dated content.
Single dated acquirer merchant manual PDF — good evidence of how scheme mandates land locally, not a continuous feed.
Static EPC reference PDF defining SEPA country scope; useful context document, rarely updated.
